team_aura: strongest per recipient per stat/effect key; same identity never adds; global/radius/family/element share key
team_event: strongest per recipient per key, no stack with duplicate events; add to self and aura then total cap
debuff: strongest same key per recipient across enemy sources; max12% relative, enemy-team scope max6; cannot lower stat below zero
rating: relative bonus multiplies pre-conversion derived rating, not percentage points; damage reduction separate multiplicative incoming factor capped 10%; existing resolver caps prevail
source: continuous aura lost on owner death/exit/range; temporary passive buff/debuff expires immediately on source death; no self heal from HP max resize
branch: B1 ×1.05 once; B2 cooldown/radius or fixed 1.5% self secondary, never a second aura; all caps apply
element: recipient must have matching authored element; never grant element
model: all active effects upper bound; element teammates excluded in simulation due to roster metadata not loaded; test real eligibility separately
